summary: Add GET /api/alerts/trends returning daily alert-creation counts bucketed per UTC calendar day and broken down by severity, mirroring the existing /api/alerts/summary slice.
scope_anchors: IAlertRepository per-UTC-day severity counts / AlertRepository GroupBy(CreatedDate.Date, Severity)
Severity enum ordering (Low=1, Medium=2, High=3, Critical=4)
constraints: Additive endpoint mirroring /api/alerts/summary end-to-end; do not change existing summary behavior.
Counts are over all alerts by CreatedDate (alert-creation counts), not filtered by IsActive.
Use injected TimeProvider (_timeProvider.GetUtcNow().UtcDateTime) for a deterministic UTC window.
Buckets: one per UTC calendar day for N days, oldest-first, filling zero-count days and zero-count severities.

days defaults to 7 with [Range(MinTrendDays=1, MaxTrendDays=90)]; non-nullable int binding + [Range] yield default [ApiController] 400 ValidationProblemDetails (no custom InvalidModelStateResponseFactory).
Reuse Severity ordering (Low=1, Medium=2, High=3, Critical=4) and AlertSeverityCountsResponse shape consistent with summary.
AlertTrendBucketResponse exposes UTC date, TotalCount, and SeverityCounts (AlertSeverityCountsResponse).
Add AlertTrendBucketResponse alongside AlertTrendsResponse in AlertTrendsResponse.cs; no test authoring in this stage.
